_: THE FIVE WING MOCKS — data for tools/mocks.mjs (same except data). Everything the catalogue does not already hold: the shelf's four frames, the Everyday album's plates, kit and papers, the feature page's operating steps, the day's landing. Pitches come from docs/CATALOGUE-20260918.json at render. HOUSE drafts throughout; Mike rules each mock A keep / B change / C cut at the sitting of 2026-09-27. Photographs are frames with labels; the served copy with sample scans is built with --photos and never committed. [09-11] Mocks 1 and 2 are retired by Mike's ruling: the shelf and the album are the real exhibit page, filled with data. Mocks 3 to 5 (the feature page, the prologue, the day's landing) still stand for the sitting. [09-11, Q5 A] Mock 3 retired: a feature lives on the albums' What It Does track. Mock 5 is a deep link into the exhibit, not a page. Only mock 4, the prologue, is still open. [09-11, Q6 A] The prologue is a track on the house sleeve above The Record. All five drawn mocks are resolved; this file is the record of the rulings.
